# Skill map

Use this when the core's routing lines do not cover the request. Only skills this session actually lists are available.
`user-only`: the host will not let the model invoke it; the user types `/name` (Claude) or `$name` (Codex), or you read its SKILL.md after approval and say it was loaded from file.
Effects other than `none` need the user's confirmation before you invoke the skill.

## Clarify what the user wants
- `grilling` (mattpocock, model; effects: subagents (read-only fact lookups)): Interview in rounds to stress-test a plan, decision or idea; each round builds on the last answers.
- `grill-me` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: none): User-only wrapper: calls grilling. Route to grilling instead.
- `grill-with-docs` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files): User-only wrapper: calls grilling and domain-modeling. Route to those two instead.
- `domain-modeling` (mattpocock, model; effects: files (GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr)): Challenge terms against GLOSSARY.md, code and ADRs; record resolved terms and ADRs.
- `brainstorming` (superpowers, model; effects: files (design doc, committed), git, subagents (builder check), browser (optional visual companion)): Find out what to build and why, lay out approaches, write and get approval for a design doc. Skip when the request is already clear.
- `to-questionnaire` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files): User-only: turn a decision you cannot answer into a questionnaire for someone else.
- `wait-what` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: none): User-only: re-pitch a message that did not land.

## Research and learning
- `research` (mattpocock, model; effects: subagents (background), files): Investigate against primary sources; write a cited Markdown report. Quick lookups stay in chat.
- `teach` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files (HTML lessons), browser): User-only: teach a concept through a workspace of lessons and references.

## Spec, plan and tickets
- `writing-plans` (superpowers, model; effects: files (docs/superpowers/plans), git): From an approved spec or requirements, write a task-by-task implementation plan. Use directly when a spec is approved.
- `to-spec` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: tracker): User-only: synthesize the conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker.
- `to-tickets` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: tracker, files): User-only: split a plan or spec into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges.
- `wayfinder` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: tracker, subagents): User-only: chart a huge, foggy effort as decision tickets and resolve them one at a time.
- `triage` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: tracker): User-only: move incoming issues and PRs through triage roles.
- `setup-matt-pocock-skills` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files, tracker): User-only: one-time repo setup (tracker, labels, doc layout) for Matt's engineering skills.

## Build
- `executing-plans` (superpowers, model; effects: code, git): Execute a written plan inline, task by task.
- `subagent-driven-development` (superpowers, model; effects: subagents, code, git): Execute a plan with implementer and reviewer subagents.
- `dispatching-parallel-agents` (superpowers, model; effects: subagents): Two or more independent tasks with no shared state.
- `implement` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: code, git, tracker): User-only: implement one spec or ticket (drives tdd and code-review).
- `implement-spec` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: subagents, code, git, tracker): User-only: implement a whole spec and its tickets with parallel subagents on one branch.
- `test-driven-development` (superpowers, model; effects: code): Test-first for any feature or bugfix; the superpowers flow's TDD.
- `tdd` (mattpocock, model; effects: code): Test-first in vertical red-green slices; Matt's flow's TDD. Pick one TDD skill, not both.
- `prototype` (mattpocock, model; effects: code, git (throwaway branch), installs): Throwaway prototype (logic HTML or UI) to answer a design question.
- `wizard` (mattpocock, model; effects: files): Generate a bash wizard for steps only a human can do (dashboards, secrets).
- `using-git-worktrees` (superpowers, model; effects: git, installs): Create an isolated workspace before feature work or plan execution.
- `codebase-design` (mattpocock, model; effects: subagents (design it twice)): Vocabulary and method for designing deep module interfaces and seams.
- `improve-codebase-architecture` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: subagents, files): User-only: scan for deepening opportunities, HTML report, then grill one.

## Debug
- `systematic-debugging` (superpowers, model; effects: code): Any bug, test failure or unexpected behaviour, before proposing fixes.
- `diagnosing-bugs` (mattpocock, model; effects: code, git, browser): Hard bugs and performance regressions: build a tight pass/fail loop first.
- `diagnosing-superpowers` (superpowers, model; effects: subagents): Why a superpowers session went wrong (repeats, cost, skipped skills).

## Review and finish
- `code-review` (mattpocock, model; effects: subagents, git (read)): Review changes since a fixed point on Standards and Spec, two parallel subagents.
- `requesting-code-review` (superpowers, model; effects: subagents, git (read)): Ask a reviewer subagent to check finished work before merging.
- `receiving-code-review` (superpowers, model; effects: none): Handle review feedback with technical rigor before changing code.
- `verification-before-completion` (superpowers, model; effects: code (runs checks)): Run the checks before claiming work is done, fixed or passing.
- `finishing-a-development-branch` (superpowers, model; effects: git): Decide how to integrate finished work: merge, PR, clean up.
- `pr` (mattpocock, model; effects: none): Write a PR body: smallest visual, evidence, door call.
- `retro` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files): User-only: look back on a session and improve the agent's environment.

## Session and writing for agents
- `handoff` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: files (temp dir)): User-only: compact the conversation into a handoff doc in the OS temp dir.
- `writing-for-agents` (mattpocock, model; effects: files): Write or edit skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md.
- `writing-skills` (superpowers, model; effects: files, subagents, git): Create, edit and test skills before deployment.
- `ask-matt` (mattpocock, user-only; effects: none): User-only router over Matt's skills. Lyra already routes; mention it when the user wants Matt's own map.
- `using-superpowers` (superpowers, model; effects: none): Superpowers bootstrap. Not exposed by default: Lyra's intake replaces its start-up rule.

## Overlaps
- Interview: grilling stress-tests a plan the user already has; brainstorming discovers what to build. Pick one per need.
- TDD: test-driven-development in the superpowers flow, tdd in Matt's flow. One per task.
- Debugging: systematic-debugging for any bug; diagnosing-bugs when a bug resists and needs a feedback loop.
- Review: code-review reviews a branch against standards and spec; requesting-code-review asks for a review of your own finished work.
- Plans: writing-plans writes a plan file; to-spec and to-tickets publish to an issue tracker (user-only).
